note: Historical Agent E medoid + greedy-PP measurements. Selected 25s are NOT ALG1. Use alg1_oracle.json for ALG1_GREEDY_LEX_PLACE_INTPT_V1.

substrate.eligibility: Official TIGER internal point (INTPTLON, INTPTLAT) covered by the Census place polygon. Same membership family as Phoenix demo construction; not authorization to freeze it nationally.
substrate.rook: Shared boundary length > 1e-6 m after make_valid and projection. Corner-only contact is not rook.
substrate.seed: Geographic medoid of eligible internal points via WGS84 geodesic; tie = lowest GEOID
substrate.growth: Greedy max union Polsby-Popper; compare at 6 decimals; tie = lowest GEOID
substrate.component_policy: Report every rook component size. Largest and seed-containing components are both recorded. Fail-closed if neither qualifying component reaches 25.

seed_meta.distance_method: WGS84 geodesic metres via pyproj.Geod(ellps='WGS84').inv on TIGER INTPTLON/INTPTLAT; sum of distances to every other eligible internal point

fail2_search.strategy: Download TIGER/Line 2025 place+tract layers for 22 states. Assign eligibility by official internal-point-in-place. Compute rook components for every place with 25–80 eligible tracts, every multipart place with >=25 eligible, every place whose AWATER exceeds ALAND with >=25 eligible, and the curated coastal/island/balance watch list.
